name: Séché Environnement SA
summary: Séché Environnement SA engages in the management, recovery, and treatment of waste products for industrial and corporate customers, and local authorities in France, Southern Africa, Latin America, Europe, and Asia. The company offers industrial waste management for hazardous and non-hazardous wastes; household waste management; medical waste treatment solutions; total waste management; rehabilitation of polluted sites and soil; regeneration, purification, and chemical synthesis; and industrial water treatment solutions.
